draft_en.subject: An 8-PoE L2+ switch for your integrator line next to Luxul and Intellinet
draft_en.body:
Hello DOW team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 8 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches your integrators buy next to Luxul and Intellinet: an 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP L2+ managed switch, Marvell-based, FCC/CE/RoHS, neutral packing - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). The 24 x PoE+ with 4 x 10G uplinks from our September mail is $180 now - that mail said $170; the CNY has moved from 7.2 to 6.7 against the dollar since.

One question: which port count do your dealers pull most, 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
